item.title: Marcella June Bechtold
item.description: Marcella June Bechtold, 82, North Manchester, passed away on Nov. 26, 2025, at the Peabody Healthcare Center. She was born on July 2, 1943, in Huntington. On Oct. 22, 1965, Marcella married Harry Thomas Bechtold. The loving memory of Marcella Bechtold will be forever cherished by her husband: Harry T. Bechtold, North Manchester; children: Jennifer...

item.title: Would-Be Mooresville Shooter Sentenced To 12 Years
item.description: An 18-year-old former Mooresville High School student has been sentenced to 12 years in state prison after admitting to a detailed plan to carry out a mass shooting on campus.

item.title: Governor Braun Makes Appointments to Various Boards, Commissions
item.description: Governor Mike Braun announced Wednesday, Nov. 26, new appointments to various state boards and commissions.

item.title: Indiana’s 2026 Data Privacy Law Includes New Consumer Rights Bill
item.description: Indiana Attorney General Todd Rokita on Tuesday, Nov. 25 released the state’s new Consumer Data Protection Bill of Rights, saying the document is intended to help Hoosiers understand and exercise their rights under the Indiana Consumer Data Protection Act before it takes effect in January.

item.title: Indiana Unveils Multi-Year Rural Health Plan In Federal Application
item.description: Indiana’s application for a share of the federal government’s $50 billion Rural Health Transformation Program lays out a sweeping, multi-year plan to stabilize struggling hospitals, expand essential local services and overhaul primary care in health systems across the state’s 64 rural counties.
